notes:
What's new in Vekrun 0.6.3 — The Host keeps running, and more gaps closed

• Closing the window keeps Vekrun Host running: the Factory keeps working and the computer stays awake. Open Vekrun from the Dock to come back; quit with ⌘Q to stop it. Turn it off, or have the Host start when you log in, under Host & Mobile.
• Fixed: turning "Keep this computer awake" off didn't save.
• Engineering Memory: correct or withdraw anything Vekrun recorded that's wrong. Your correction is what the Coordinator, Council and agents get from then on; the old version stays in history.
• Dev environment: start and stop the project's Docker Compose services (waiting until each is healthy), and run its own database preparation and seed commands, with live progress and the output.
• Verify an evidence receipt someone sent you, offline (⌘K → "Verify an evidence receipt"): who signed it, whether you trust that key, whether its commit is in your project, and what wasn't verified.
• Live Share: on apps whose security policy blocks Review Mode, reviewers get a plain Feedback link and page instead of nothing.
